name: Omarchy Pets
author: Raiden-MeixElysia
description: An animated Codex Pets companion in the bar: it plays its own moves on a random schedule, looks at your cursor, can be pinned to the desktop, and strolls around where you drop it.

schema.label: Pet
schema.description: Directory name under the pets folder. Pick it from the panel.

schema.label: Pets folder
schema.description: Where Codex Pets packages are unzipped.

schema.label: Pinned
schema.description: Keep the pet on the desktop with the panel closed.

schema.label: Pinned X
schema.description: Left edge of the pinned pet in screen pixels. -1 keeps it below its bar icon; dragging the pet sets it.

schema.label: Pinned Y
schema.description: Top edge of the pinned pet in screen pixels. -1 keeps it below its bar icon; dragging the pet sets it.

schema.label: Pinned size
schema.description: Scale of the pet while pinned to the desktop. 1 is full size; the bar icon and panel preview stay full size.

schema.label: Random behaviour
schema.description: Play a random move every 8-20 seconds.

schema.label: Animate
schema.description: Off shows a single still frame and runs no timer.

schema.label: Walk around
schema.description: The pinned pet strolls around the spot you dropped it. Turning it on with a zero radius sets a 150 px radius.

schema.label: Walk radius
schema.description: Distance in pixels the pinned pet strolls around the spot you dropped it. 0 keeps it in place.

schema.label: Minimum stride
schema.description: Shortest distance in pixels of one stroll, so the pet does not just shuffle a few pixels. Never above the walk radius.

schema.label: Randomness
schema.description: How often the pet moves on its own, idle actions and strolls alike. 50 is the natural pace, 0 half as often, 100 five times as often.
